items.question: What happens to the Brahma-state when the mind becomes fisherman-nature?
items.inference: The Brahma-state is abandoned as the mind becomes fisherman-nature.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation between citta and dhīvarātmakam remains uncertain.
items.plain_english: Then the Brahma-state was abandoned; the mind became fisherman-nature.
